text.description_html:
Bommer CL4040-7-632 - 7" Single Acting Spring Hinge with Classic Ball Tips

Packaged completed with a Pair (2) Single Action Spring Door Hinges plus #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws . Non-template screw hole pattern for use on metal or wood doors (ANSI K81011F).

Bommer spring hinges are certified Grade 1 (highest grade) for 1 million cycles and made in the USA. For wood or metal doors 2" thick.

Specifications for Bommer CL4040-7 7" Spring Hinge with Ball Tips

  • Height: 7"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square Corners
  • Gauge of Metal: .114
  • Door Thickness: 2" Thick Doors
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • Factory Set Spring Tension
  • Non-Handed
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1 for 1 million cycles.
  • UL Listed For Fire Rated Door Applications ("A" label openings)
  • Full Mortise - ANSI K81011F
  • Available Finishes: Bright Brass
  • Bommer 4040-7 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)
